xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4374: Memory extraction: add a claude-cli provider so subscription-only hosts extract observations

plan.title: Memory extraction: add a claude-cli provider so subscription-only hosts extract observations
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One provider feature: the lint counts docs/MODEL-CALLS.md and configuration/workspaces.mdx as two separate subsystems and the CLI doctor text plus its test as two more, so 22 files land in 7 path groups. The provider is unusable from Settings without the union widening, and the doctor/docs changes describe the provider, so splitting them into sibling issues would ship a provider nobody can select or find.

narratives.Problem: memory.extraction.provider has two providers: anthropic (Anthropic SDK, needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN in the process env; a Claude subscription login does not authenticate it) and cliproxy (default model gpt-4.1-nano, which the local CLIProxy rejects). A host with only a Claude subscription has no working provider, so no observations have been extracted on the operator's host since 2026-08-13 (every health.json shows 'Could not resolve authentication method').
narratives.Proposal: Add a claude-cli extraction provider (src/lib/memory/providers/claude-cli.ts) that runs claude -p with the PAN-2657 hardened args plus --no-session-persistence and --system-prompt, through a shared runner (src/lib/background-ai/claude-structured.ts) that titles also use. The runner parses the stdout envelope on every exit code and keys errors on is_error, so a 'Not logged in' result becomes ExtractionProviderAuthError and health reason provider-auth-failed. The provider declares latencyClass 'background'; query expansion filters the selection to interactive providers on every surface and falls back with reason provider-non-interactive without spawning or writing health. Config types, the settings API and both Settings pickers accept claude-cli; pan doctor's fix text and the docs name it.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the default extraction provider (stays anthropic) or auto-detecting a subscription login
- Fixing cliproxy's hardcoded gpt-4.1-nano default model (the issue lists it 'Separately')
- Changing registry.classification.provider unions (schema.ts lines 130, 142, 227; domain-mergers.ts line 21)
- Changing the Anthropic model preset (presets.ts line 141 still writes memory.extraction.provider: anthropic)
- Adding --no-session-persistence or --system-prompt to conversation title/About calls; buildStructuredClaudeArgs output must stay byte-identical
- Validating that a claude-cli model is a Claude model
- A Settings UI hint that query expansion skips claude-cli
- A new concurrency pool, queue or CPU admission for memory spawns
- Any synchronous child-process call (execSync/spawnSync) in server-reachable code

autoDecisions.summary: claude-cli is a tool-less utility completion, not an agent, so the no-oneshot-agents rule does not apply
autoDecisions.rationale: It runs with --tools '', --disallowedTools mcp__*, --permission-mode dontAsk, --safe-mode, --setting-sources '', a scratch cwd and no session file; it has no lifecycle to lose. Titles and About summaries (PAN-2657) are the accepted precedent.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract one shared spawn runner used by titles and the provider instead of writing a second spawn
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo invariant 'one variant per operation in src/lib'; the title spawn has the same stdout-envelope bug (probe: exit 1, empty stderr, cause only in stdout).

autoDecisions.summary: --no-session-persistence and --system-prompt are provider-only extraArgs; title args stay unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: Probes showed no session JSONL is written and input tokens halve; keeping buildStructuredClaudeArgs byte-identical keeps the PAN-2657 hardening tests and title behavior stable.

autoDecisions.summary: Record total_cost_usd and count it toward the per-issue daily cap
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches recordTitleCost, matches the operator's request to show hypothetical cost without subscriptions, and the cap stays a brake on spawn count; probed cost ~$0.0004-0.0013 per call.

autoDecisions.summary: claude-cli defaultModel reuses the anthropic extraction default through one exported constant
autoDecisions.rationale: claude-haiku-5-5 is the documented memory extraction default (model-presets.mdx line 118, MODEL-CALLS.md line 60); no new hardcoded model literal is introduced.

autoDecisions.summary: The non-interactive gate lives in query expansion and passes a filtered selection through the policy's existing deps.selection
autoDecisions.rationale: Covers primary and fallback without widening the policy result union used by extract.ts, rollup.ts and feature-registry-population.ts, and never writes health.json for a skip.

autoDecisions.summary: Query expansion skips background providers on every surface, not only user-prompt
autoDecisions.rationale: The spawn surface awaits expansion with no timeout (injection.ts resolveQueryExpansion), so a 2-6 s spawn would delay every agent launch.

autoDecisions.summary: 60 s extraction timeout; temperature and maxTokens ignored by claude-cli
autoDecisions.rationale: Probed worst case 5.8 s; the CLI exposes no temperature or max-token flags, and effort is already pinned low by buildStructuredClaudeArgs.

autoDecisions.summary: cliproxy's gpt-4.1-nano default stays out of scope
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body marks it 'Separately'; it is a different provider and needs its own decision about the replacement default.

items.title: Move the hardened claude -p spawn into a shared runner that reads the stdout envelope

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create src/lib/background-ai/claude-structured.ts: move buildStructuredClaudeArgs() and backgroundAiScratchCwd() verbatim (with the PAN-2657 comment); add ClaudeStructuredFailure, ClaudeStructuredCallError, isClaudeAuthFailure (401/403 or /not logged in|please run \/login|invalid api key|oauth token has expired|authentication_error|unauthorized/i) and runClaudeStructured(input, deps). Input: model, prompt, schema, timeoutMs, signal?, extraArgs? (appended after the hardening flags), providerEnv?: (model) => Promise<Record<string,string>> (resolved AFTER the min-version check and overlaid on buildChildEnv()). Deps: spawn?, resolveBinary? (default dynamically imports ../harness-binary.js prepareHarnessLaunch('claude-code', {model})). The module must NEVER import ../agents.js or ../agents/provider-env.js, statically or dynamically: madge counts dynamic edges and provider-env reaches memory/providers/registry.ts, so that import would close a new cycle. On close it parses stdout first: is_error true -> ClaudeStructuredCallError; non-zero exit -> ClaudeStructuredCallError with stderr || result text; unparseable -> Error; else resolve the envelope. Timeout and abort kill with SIGTERM; an already-aborted signal spawns nothing. In transcript-summary.ts re-export the two moved helpers, make invokeClaudeStructured call runClaudeStructured({model, prompt, schema, timeoutMs, providerEnv: (m) => getProviderEnvForModel(m)}) then recordTitleCost and return structured_output; keep the static ../agents.js import; remove only the imports left unused (spawn, mkdirSync, join, buildChildEnv, getOverdeckHome, getModelEffortLevels). transcript-summary.test.ts and transcript-summary-preflight.test.ts must stay unedited and green. New tests per PRD WI-1 step 5 with a fake child process and vi.useFakeTimers() for the timeout case.

items.title: Given a fake child that exits 1 with empty stderr and the stdout envelope {is_error:true,result:'Not logged in · Please run /login'}, runClaudeStructured rejects with ClaudeStructuredCallError whose failure.authFailure is true and whose message contains 'Not logged in'
Given exit 0 with is_error true, runClaudeStructured rejects; given exit 0 with is_error false and structured_output, it resolves the parsed envelope

Under vi.useFakeTimers(), advancing past timeoutMs calls kill('SIGTERM') and rejects with 'claude invocation timed out after <n>ms'; an aborting signal kills and rejects, and an already-aborted signal spawns nothing

The spawned argv equals buildStructuredClaudeArgs(schema, model) followed by extraArgs, and git diff origin/main shows no change to transcript-summary.test.ts or transcript-summary-preflight.test.ts while vitest reports both files green

claude-structured.ts contains no import of agents.js or agents/provider-env.js, npm run lint:circular passes with scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt unchanged, and transcript-summary.ts has fewer lines than on origin/main
Add the claude-cli extraction provider with a background latency class

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Add optional latencyClass ('interactive' | 'background', absent = interactive) to ExtractionProvider in types.ts and map 'claude-cli' to 'anthropic' in extractionProviderToAiProvider. Export DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_EXTRACTION_MODEL from anthropic.ts. Create claude-cli.ts (module header states the no-oneshot argument, background latency, cost rule, ignored temperature/maxTokens): ClaudeCliExtractionProvider(run = runClaudeStructured) with name 'claude-cli', latencyClass 'background', timeout 60_000, extraArgs ['--no-session-persistence', '--system-prompt', CLAUDE_CLI_EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT], prompt = buildJsonExtractionPrompt(prompt, schema); maps an authFailure ClaudeStructuredCallError to ExtractionProviderAuthError; data = structured_output or parseJsonPayload(result); cost = total_cost_usd or calculateExtractionCost; recordExtractionCost with provider 'claude-cli' and requestId 'claude-cli-<session_id>'. Register it in registry.ts and add isInteractiveExtractionProvider() and interactiveExtractionSelection() (code in PRD); export them and the class from index.ts. Tests per PRD WI-2 step 5 with an injected run stub; re-register the default provider in afterEach. The provider passes no providerEnv (getProviderEnvForModel returns {} for Anthropic models and buildChildEnv strips ANTHROPIC_* keys, so the child authenticates with the Claude Code login) and must not import agents.js or agents/provider-env.js. IMPLEMENTATION CHECKPOINT after the tests pass: run the live one-liner from the PRD section 'Implementation checkpoint (live CLI)' (npx tsx -e ... new ClaudeCliExtractionProvider().extract('Name one color.', schema)) and paste its output into the PR description; if the host has no Claude Code login, say so in the PR description and rely on claude-cli-extraction-e2e.

items.title: Given a run stub returning {structured_output:{summary:'ok'}, total_cost_usd:0.0009, session_id:'s1'}, extract() returns data {summary:'ok'}, cost.usd 0.0009, provider 'claude-cli' and requestId 'claude-cli-s1', and records one cost event
extract() passes timeoutMs 60000 and extraArgs containing '--no-session-persistence' and '--system-prompt' to the runner, and falls back to parsing the result string when structured_output is absent

When the runner throws a Not-logged-in ClaudeStructuredCallError, extract() throws ExtractionProviderAuthError, and extractWithProviderPolicy records health reason 'provider-auth-failed'; a non-auth failure throws a plain error and records 'extraction-failed'

getExtractionProvider('claude-cli') returns a provider with latencyClass 'background' and defaultModel 'claude-haiku-5-5'; interactiveExtractionSelection drops claude-cli from primary or fallback and returns null when only claude-cli remains
End-to-end test: provider claude-cli writes an observation through the pipeline

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. New test file modeled on tests/lib/memory/e2e.test.ts setup (setupOverdeckTestDb, upsertProjectFromConfig, createWorkspace, closeMemoryFtsDatabases). items.title: Given settings provider 'claude-cli' and a stubbed runner, extractFromTranscriptDelta returns status 'written' and the workspace observations/<date>.jsonl contains exactly one line whose summary equals the stub's summary

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Add 'provider-non-interactive' to QueryExpansionResult['reason']. Injected expand calls are unchanged. Add the test 'never runs claude-cli for query expansion and falls back with provider-non-interactive' with a registered ClaudeCliExtractionProvider(runSpy) and OVERDECK_MEMORY_PROVIDER/MODEL unset.
